scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,driver -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @rampflow/api dev" "pnpm --filter @rampflow/web dev" "pnpm --filter @rampflow/driver dev"
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/checkout-env.mjs --e2e run -- sh -c 'pnpm --silent db:reset && podman run --rm --network host --ipc host -e API_PORT -e WEB_PORT -e DRIVER_PORT -e APP_ORIGIN -e DATABASE_URL -e MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL -e SMTP_HOST -e SMTP_PORT -e CI -v "$PWD":/work:z -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble node_modules/.bin/playwright test "$@"' sh
scripts.test:e2e:host: node scripts/checkout-env.mjs --e2e run -- sh -c 'pnpm --silent db:reset && playwright test "$@"' sh
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm docs:check && pnpm i18n:derive --check && pnpm api:docs --check
scripts.ux:screens: podman run --rm --network host --ipc host -v "$PWD":/work:z -w /work -e UX_SCREENS_OUT mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble node scripts/ux-screens.mjs
scripts.docs:screens: node scripts/checkout-env.mjs run -- sh -c 'podman run --rm --network host --ipc host -e APP_ORIGIN -e DOCS_SCREENS_OUT -v "$PWD":/work:z -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble node scripts/docs-screens.mjs'
